result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The `Scoping*` tests in `codeanalyzer` pass, but I didn't add tests for the new matches. I haven't run the new patterns against sample `.htm`, `.xml`, `build-gradle.js` or `app.js` files.

- **Generated HTML pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and `<meta name="generator">` rules had `(html|html|xhtml)`. They now read `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match and `.html` and `.xhtml` still do.
- **.NET `<doc>` XML and `// Generated by` JavaScript:** the file patterns were `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js`, which only matched a file literally named `.xml` or `.js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`.
- **Gradle scripts:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` became `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` lands in build-and-deployment. `.gradle` files such as `build.gradle` still match through their own rule.

Hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of those scopes because each rule still needs its content pattern to match.
